answers.text: Osmosis is the movement of water across a partially permeable membrane from an area of high water concentration to an area of low water concentration. Diffusion is the net movement of particles from an area of high concentration to an area of low concentration.

(a) In the induced-fit model the substrate binds to the active site, and the active site changes shape slightly to fit closely around the substrate. This strains the substrate's bonds so the reaction happens more easily, then the products are released and the enzyme is unchanged. (b) At high temperatures the bonds holding the enzyme's tertiary structure break, so the active site loses its shape and the enzyme is denatured. The substrate no longer fits, so the reaction rate falls.
Plant cells have a cell wall but animal cells do not. Plant cells contain chloroplasts for photosynthesis while animal cells do not.
Mature red blood cells lose their nucleus to make more room for haemoglobin, so they can carry more oxygen. It also keeps the cell small and flexible so it can squeeze through capillaries.
